property_summary: After calling addReward(address) on the contract, the owner should remain the original deployer in the reference (P), but in the mutant (M) the owner changes to address(0) because transferOwnership is a no-op when ownership is transferred via renounceOwnership, which relies on transferOwnership internally.
change_summary: Replace the body of transferOwnership with a no-op, so the owner never changes.
